data.title: Choose the correct answer for each question.
data.description: Practise nuanced article choices with generic reference, institutions, abstract nouns, titles, geography and fixed expressions.
learningPoints: Distinguish generic and specific reference with singular, plural and uncountable nouns.
Use zero article with abstract nouns in general meanings.
Use the with specific abstract or uncountable reference.
Recognise institutional uses such as prison, school, university and hospital.
Use articles accurately with geographical names and titles.
Interpret article choice as part of meaning, not only grammar.

sections.explain: A singular countable noun can use THE to represent a whole class in formal generalisation.

words.word: The tiger is an endangered species.
A tiger is the endangered species in all formal generalisations.
Tiger is an endangered species.

sections.explain: Plural nouns normally take zero article when referring to a class in general.

words.word: Tigers are endangered in many regions.
The tigers are endangered in many regions, meaning all tigers generally.
A tigers are endangered in many regions.

sections.summary: Using zero article with an abstract noun.
sections.explain: Abstract nouns often take zero article when used generally.

words.word: Freedom is important to many people.
The freedom is important to many people in general.
A freedom is important to many people.

sections.explain: Use THE when the abstract noun is made specific by context.

words.word: The freedom we gained was hard won.
Freedom we gained was hard won in this specific reference.
A freedom we gained was hard won.

sections.explain: Use zero article when an institution is used for its normal purpose.

words.word: He was sent to prison for five years.
He was sent to the prison for five years, meaning imprisonment as an institution.
He was sent to a prison as the fixed institutional expression.

sections.explain: Use THE when referring to the physical building rather than its institutional function.

words.word: I went to the prison to visit my brother.
I went to prison to visit my brother, meaning I was incarcerated.
I went to a prison as the only possible definite reference.

sections.summary: Using zero article before most titles + names.
sections.explain: Titles followed by a personal name normally take no article.

words.word: Professor Green will speak first.
The Professor Green will speak first.
A Professor Green will speak first, when used as his formal title.

sections.summary: Using 'the' with a title without a name.
sections.explain: A title used as a unique role may take THE when no personal name follows.

words.word: The Prime Minister gave a statement.
Prime Minister gave a statement, with no name and unique office.
A Prime Minister gave a statement, referring to the current unique office-holder.

sections.summary: Using articles with geographical group names.
sections.explain: Plural country or island group names often take THE.

words.word: The Netherlands is in Europe.
Netherlands is in Europe.
A Netherlands is in Europe.

sections.summary: Using zero article in fixed expressions.
sections.explain: Some common expressions use zero article even though a noun is singular.

words.word: She went home after work.
She went to the home after the work.
She went a home after a work.
